chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd Al-Yaqťīni, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Sa'id Al-Qammāť, from Ibn Abi Ya'fūr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was in the house of Fatimah (peace be upon her), with Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) sitting on his lap. Suddenly, he wept and fell in prostration. Then he said: 'O Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad! Indeed, the Most High, the Most Exalted, appeared to me in your house at this hour in the most beautiful form and appearance, and said to me: 'O Muhammad, do you love Al-Husayn?' I replied, 'Yes, he is the coolness of my eye, my flower, the fruit of my heart, and the skin between my two eyes.' He said to me, O Muhammad, while placing His hand on the head of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him): 'Blessed is the newborn upon whom have come My blessings, My prayers, My mercy, and My pleasure. And upon him are My curse, My wrath, My punishment, My disgrace, and My chastisement, for whoever kills him, opposes him, contends with him, and competes with him. Indeed, he is the Master of Martyrs from the first to the last, in this world and the Hereafter.' And he mentioned the hadith.

key_terms.الْعَلِيَّ الْأَعْلَى: The Most High, the Most Exalted (Allah)
key_terms.قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي: Coolness of my eye (term of deep affection)

ai.seo_question: What is the divine declaration regarding Husayn ibn Ali in the house of Fatimah?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith highlights the divine origin of Husayn’s status as 'Sayyid al-Shuhada' (Master of Martyrs) through a direct theophanic encounter in Fatimah’s home. It underscores the Shia doctrine of *al-Lu'na* (the curse), linking the Prophet’s love for Husayn to Allah’s specific blessings and the eternal condemnation of his killers, thereby establishing a theological basis for mourning and veneration.
